The application is accessible via internal services:
- Backend (GraphQL): {{ include "app.fullname" . }}-back:{{ .Values.back.service.port }}
- Frontend: {{ include "app.fullname" . }}-front:{{ .Values.front.service.port }}

{{- $backReplicas := ternary .Values.autoscaling.maxReplicas .Values.back.replicaCount .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
{{- if or (gt (int $backReplicas) 1) (and .Values.worker.enabled (gt (int .Values.worker.replicaCount) 1)) }}

The api runs in more than one replica. Two things to check before load arrives
(chart README, section «Несколько реплик»):

- PostgreSQL connections. Every api process opens its own pools — application,
  LangGraph checkpointer, LangGraph store — so the ceiling is roughly
  (back + worker pods) × 3 × `pool.max` (10 by default), i.e. ~30 connections
  per pod. Compare that with the server's `max_connections` before adding pods.
- Requests on the pods. Without `back.resources` / `worker.resources` the
  scheduler may place every replica on one node, and an HPA on CPU utilisation
  has nothing to compute against.
{{- end }}
